---
title: "Computational environment"
---

R session of the last render. Package versions are pinned in `renv.lock`.

```{r session}
#| echo: false
suppressMessages({
  for (p in c("VCA", "lme4", "brms", "mcr", "pROC", "binom", "epiR", "DTComPair", "cutpointr",
              "OptimalCutpoints", "presize", "MKmisc", "mice", "refineR", "nlme", "survival",
              "timeROC", "rms", "ggplot2", "knitr")) library(p, character.only = TRUE)
})
cat("Rendered:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z"), "\n\n")
sessionInfo()
```
